title: Improving Commonsense Bias Classification by Mitigating the Influence of Demographic Terms

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying polarization by comparing changes in a BERT model's sentiment/polarization classifications (positive, neutral, negative) of commonsense sentences when origin-related demographic terms (e.g., nationalities, regions) are masked versus unmasked.
